{{Spoiler}}

'''Canned golden apples''' are the secret preservation of the [[golden apple]]. They heal {{Hp|8}} and grant {{EffectLink|Absorption}} II for 2 minutes and {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} II for 20 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/canned_golden_apples.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[baked golden apple]], sugar and a glass bottle. The recipe is secret and never enters the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating them takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|8}} and gives Absorption II (4 extra hearts) for 2:00 and Regeneration II for 0:20. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten. Making them grants ''Wait, you can make that?''
